verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents CEL expressions used in event filters, which are rules evaluated on incoming events to decide which workflows run. A webhooks page and cron triggers (docs-16) add further automatic trigger paths, and a community user praises its 'flow-based UI with triggers'. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of event-triggered workflow definitions (the webhooks and event-filter evidence is only page titles or one-line mentions), and hands-on corroboration that event-filter rules fire actions as described.
